The gapped dispersion with velocity $v>0$ and gap $\Delta>0$ is
\begin{equation}
E(k) = \sqrt{v^2k^2+\Delta^2} ,
\label{eq:disp}
\end{equation}
and doubling the momentum doubles the energy,
\begin{equation}
E(2k) = 2E(k) .
\label{eq:double}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
